prompt: Deinonychus, 3.4 meter dromaeosaur dinosaur, athletic mid-sized build, narrow deep skull with recurved serrated teeth, muscular S-curved neck, long arms with three clawed fingers and palms facing inward, large curved sickle claw on second toe of each foot, long stiff tail bound straight by bony rods, body covered in dense filamentous feathers with longer pennaceous feathers on arms and tail, bare scaly feet, olive green with dark grey dorsal mottling and a pale striped throat, poised hunting stance with spine horizontal and head forward, stylized realism, game-ready low-poly creature, clean topology, neutral stance facing forward, no base, no scenery
texture_prompt: brown mottled feathers, cream belly, throat and face stripe, orange eyes, dark brown wing and tail-fan feathers with pale cream bars, pale scaly legs, black sickle claws

clips.attack_primary: Feathered dromaeosaur steps in and bites, both feathered arms grabbing forward with the claws spread and raking down on the bite
clips.attack_heavy: Sickle slash: rocks onto one leg with the other foot hauled high and the sickle claw cocked, wings flared for balance, then drives the foot down through the prey and rakes it back
clips.knockdown: Mid-sized feathered predatory dinosaur is hit hard in the flank, skids, and drops onto its side stunned
clips.alert: Wing-and-fan display: rears, throws the barred wings wide and the tail fan up, screeches with a head shake, then drops into a low hunting crouch

ASSUMPTION radii (metres at size 1, plus the target's radius).
